title: tracker digest ack --json
description: Records that a project's digest was seen (DESIGN.md §2.6, §2.7), from an interactive terminal only, after the digest and the question on stderr. Without a terminal, or if the digest changed while it asked, it exits 1 with the error shape and records nothing.

acknowledged.description: The time recorded in digests.json. The next digest lists only what comes after it.

verified.description: How many auto-verified items the acknowledged digest listed.
